events.title: Cookies, Crafts, & Climate
events.summary: Join the Center for Campus Involvement for an afternoon of crafting and conversation. Make climate stripes friendship bracelets, enjoy fall treats, and connect with others interested in sustainability and environmental issues.
events.registration: Students interested in sustainability, climate change, and the environment are invited to join the Center for Campus Involvement in making climate stripes friendship bracelets while snacking on some fall treats!
